body:
## Parent

https://github.com/EvgenyHitexis/EucWatch/issues/43

## What to build

Make the laptop's actual watch-sized pointer interaction follow the agreed Settings hierarchy and four-field editor navigation. A swipe up returns one level and discards an open preset draft; left/right swipes move through fields in either direction without losing unfinished input, including while a keypad is open.

Use #43, the domain glossary, ADR 0002 and the confirmed interaction specification. The local editor ticket establishes whole-editor Save/Cancel, removed obsolete controls and transient input; this slice routes physical gestures through that behavior rather than reintroducing per-field completion.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] From the riding dashboard, swipe down opens Settings. Actual upward pointer gestures return preset editor → preset selection → Settings → riding dashboard, one level per gesture. Right is no longer a back gesture anywhere along this preset Settings path.
- [ ] Up from the preset editor, including an active name/numeric keypad or validation/save-failure view, performs whole-editor Cancel: discard all draft/input, leave saved configuration/revision unchanged and return directly to preset selection. It does not merely close input, save a field or request the wheel.
- [ ] Left advances Name → Pedal sensitivity → Dynamic assist → Pedal dip compensation → Name; right reverses and wraps Name → Pedal dip compensation. Both directions work from normal editor pages and open keypads. Right never exits this editor.
- [ ] Retain every field's draft text/value and inclusion across page changes, including empty/unfinished numeric input and the active keypad's latest text. Navigation neither validates into a persisted value nor loses edits. Subsequent whole-editor Save collects all fields; invalid unfinished values still receive the editor's visible validation outcome.
- [ ] Name character-page controls remain usable without consuming left/right editor gestures as alphabet paging. Save and Cancel remain available and retain their whole-editor meanings throughout. Ensure gestures do not also fire taps on former Clear/Back/Set targets or cause double navigation.
- [ ] Update rendered prompts, accessibility descriptions and instructions to the actual up/down/left/right behavior within 240×240. Keep preset Clear, Save slot, editor Back and Set/Done absent/inactive; character clearing remains available.
- [ ] Update shared Settings back routing/instructions consistently for independent alert editing while preserving its existing save/cancel semantics. Preserve the separate riding preset menu's entry/return and one-tap application, dashboard freshness, sleeping/wake/button and recovery behavior. Navigation emits no wheel-setting packet or implicit save.

## Tests and evidence

- Drive real pointer down/move/up events against the built Canvas and backend, not only public action shortcuts. Retain a reusable ordered gesture/input trace with literal expected screens, field pages, draft text, saved revision and command output for watch replay.
- Cover a full down/open/up/up/up hierarchy traversal, both end-page wraps in both directions, repeated navigation across all four slots, and the same traversal with name/numeric keypads open. Use case/spaces/digits/backspace/character clearing so input preservation is demonstrated by subsequent Save/restart.
- Leave a numeric field empty/unfinished, navigate away/back and attempt Save; retain text and show validation. After multi-field changes, test up and Cancel separately from each input view; old saved values survive reopening/restart with zero new packets.
- Exercise up during a failed-save/validation state, rapid/delayed input and pointer gestures crossing old control coordinates. Assert no accidental tap, save, clear, per-field completion or editor exit on horizontal gestures.
- Run focused browser/application navigation/lifecycle checks and frontend typechecking/build, retaining actual 240×240 renderings and expected/observed actions. Regression-check independent alerts, riding-menu navigation/application and wake/button behavior without live hardware operations.

## Blocked by

- https://github.com/EvgenyHitexis/EucWatch/issues/46 — supplies whole-editor draft/input retention, Save/Cancel semantics and the revised controls that these gestures must operate.
title: Implement laptop preset swipe navigation with retained keypad input
